claims.statement: Organization or enterprise navigation offers corresponding account-settings links with marketing parameters. These examples do not establish selected tenant identity, membership or permission to inspect financial information.

The organization billing-manager capability list includes metered usage across organization repositories, organization budgets, member additional Copilot budget requests, CSV usage reports, payment history/receipts, payment-method changes, Free/Team plan changes, billing-manager membership and sponsorship changes. Read and write capabilities are distinct; role documentation neither proves a user's assigned role nor grants this agent authority to perform financial or membership writes.
The organization sidebar Billing & Licensing click is contextual navigation with a decorative icon, not actual access, billing authority or a verified financial record.

The pinned notice states Spark and cloud-agent premium requests receive dedicated SKUs from November 1, 2025 for cost visibility and budget control. It does not establish current SKU availability, prices, budget effectiveness or transition to AI-credit billing.

Under enhanced-billing-platform, volume/subscription/prepaid enterprise-license agreements retain their billing until expiry OR invitation to transition, with a metered option at renewal. The invitation alternative qualifies the earlier do-i-have-usage-based fragment's expiry-only description: preserve both source claims rather than silently asserting identical transition timing; an invitation is not acceptance or completed migration.

The detailed usage report is described as available only in the web interface, not REST /usage, which supplies summarized billing information. A successful summary API response cannot establish detailed-report completeness or justify fabricated granular billing data.
